messages.content: In one short sentence, what is the Kiln inference server?

completions.text: Kiln is a single-GPU LLM inference server with live LoRA training over HTTP.
Kiln is a pure-Rust inference and online-training stack for Qwen3.5-4B.
Kiln is a tool for managing kiln operations in pottery and ceramics.
Kiln helps you fire pottery at the correct temperature schedule.
Kiln targets Qwen3.5-4B specifically and tunes its kernels for that one architecture.
Kiln runs Qwen3.5-4B with hand-tuned hybrid GDN plus GQA forward-pass kernels.
Kiln runs many different LLMs across different sizes.
Kiln supports any HuggingFace model out of the box.
